answer: Use a bonded identity registry: each agent registers by burning a small stake and submitting a hardware-attested key plus a VDF proof seeded by a shared sparrow signal; the registry checks key uniqueness and clusters shared funding/behavior, then slashes and burns the full bond of any duplicate cluster. Sybil attackers must burn a real stake per fake identity and lose all bonds when linked, while honest agents recover their bond after a velvet reputation period.
